sections.heading: How Snowflake and Databricks organise governance
sections.body: Snowflake runs governance through a dedicated unit, while Databricks organises the same work around partner platforms. The two structures lead to different delivery models.

sections.heading: Partnerships and investment
sections.body: Both Snowflake and Databricks report platform partnerships, and both disclose continued investment in governance capability, though in different places.
